reviewNotes:
RetroFold turns iPhone Duo into a 90s handheld console. Closed, the cover display shows the cartridges: swipe and pick one. Unfolded, the inner display shows the game screen above the fold and the controls below; folding pauses the game. On an iPhone without a hinge, the whole console shows on screen: tap a cartridge on the shelf to play (Lunar Hinge uses the A button or the up arrow instead of folding).

Free app with one optional in-app purchase, RetroFold Pro (non-consumable, com.padelup.retrofold.pro). Open it from Store in the toolbar, or tap a locked (dusty) cartridge. It unlocks 4 more cartridges, every console skin, the extra sound packs and 3 screen modes. Restore Purchases is on the same screen.

All games are original. No account, no ads, no network access, no data collection.
